maddeler.e:
افتتحا (form VIII)
# اِفْتَتَحَا (iftataḥā) /if.ta.ta.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past active of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اُفْتُتِحَا (uftutiḥā) /uf.tu.ti.ħaː/: third-person masculine dual past passive of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
# اِفْتَتِحَا (iftatiḥā) /if.ta.ti.ħaː/: second-person dual imperative of اِفْتَتَحَ (iftataḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
